name: Assets2Godot (Poly Haven, ambientCG & BlendKit browser inside Godot)
summary: Godot 4.4+ editor plugin that turns the editor into an asset workspace: browse and download the CC0 Poly Haven and ambientCG catalogs (models, textures, HDRIs) and BlendKit, plus index your own asset drives, with staged imports into the project and automatic .blend-to-.tres material conversion via a local Blender. Now listed on the official Godot Asset Store.

access.notes: Alpha (v0.9.1 marked unstable on the store). Poly Haven/ambientCG need no account; BlendKit login optional and its assets follow BlendKit terms. Based on BlenderKit's bk_godot. Code written with AI assistants, ships no AI art.

procedure: In Godot 4.4+, open the AssetLib/Asset Store tab and search Assets2Godot, or download assets2godot_v0.9.1.zip (with BlendKit client binaries) or the _nobin zip from GitHub releases.
Copy addons/assets2godot into your project and enable it in Project Settings > Plugins.
Open the Poly Haven, ambientCG or BlendKit tab, pick an asset and download; imports are staged into res://imported_assets/.

stats.size: 34.5 MB full zip / 352 KB without binaries

verdict.why: Useful for Godot devs: puts the big CC0 libraries (Poly Haven, ambientCG) plus BlendKit one click away in the editor; fresh store listing, GPLv2, downloads verified. Alpha quality, small audience so far.
